basic_details.short_information: AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026 has 3 posts in the Department of Urology for an ICMR-funded multi-centre bladder cancer trial: Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical), Project Technical Support-III and Project Technical Support-II. All three are purely temporary contract posts for 11 months, which may be extended. The pay is a consolidated Rs. 56000/-, Rs. 28000/- or Rs. 20,000/- per month plus HRA @20%. Send the application in the prescribed format to [email protected] so that it reaches by 05.00 PM on 30 October 2026. The tentative date of the walk-in interview is 3 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Bhubaneswar
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bhubaneswar is a Statutory Body under the aegis of the Ministry of H & F.W., Govt. of India. It is located at Sijua, Post: Dumuduma, Bhubaneswar-751019. These posts are in an ICMR-funded project led by PI Dr. Kalandi Barik, Assistant Professor, and Co-PI Dr Swarnendu Mandal, Associate Professor, both of the Department of Urology, AIIMS Bhubaneswar.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: P.G Degree in Life Sciences/Biotechnology, preferably with at least 1-year experience of working in health sector, ICMR, AIIMS etc. or in the Scientific Dept. / Organizations Experience in clinical research project management and patient handling Qualification and experience should be in the relevant discipline/field and from an Institution of repute. Experience should have been gained after acquiring the minimum essential qualification. Persons already in regular time scale service under any Government Department/Organizations are not eligible to apply. Meeting the essential/educational qualification does not guarantee selection. The cut-off date for the age limit is the date of the walk-in interview, which is the date of interview. Age relaxation is admissible for SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates as per government rules. Check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emoluments are consolidated per month, with HRA @20% on top of the pay for each post: Rs. 56000/- (Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical)), Rs. 28000/- (Project Technical Support-III) and Rs. 20,000/- (Project Technical Support-II). The rates of emoluments/stipend are as per the guidelines and as per the sanction. The posts will be filled purely on a temporary contract basis. The tenure of each post is 11 months, which may be extended with satisfactory performance and project extension. Further continuation or extension depends on the needs of the project, performance evaluation and the approval of the competent authority, case by case. Benefits of Provident Fund, Pension Scheme, Leave Travel Concession, Medical claim, etc. are not admissible. A contract appointee has no claim to a regular post in the institute, the Funding Agency or any Department of the Government of India. The contract service gives no right to further assignment, transfer or absorption. An undertaking to this effect must be submitted at the time of joining. Either side may end the engagement at any time with one month's notice. The contract can be ended at once, or before the notice period is over, by paying one month's contractual amount. The appointee cannot pay the one-month amount instead of serving the notice and must serve the full notice period. Leave is as per the Funding Agency/Institutional policy for contract staff under AIIMS, BBSR guidelines.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the Application Form in the prescribed format attached to the notice (Advt. No.: AIIMS/BBSR/UROLOGY/RECRUITMENT/2026/01). Applications in any other format will not be considered. On the form, fill in the date of the walk-in interview, your personal and address details, educational qualifications, experience (organisation, post, period, scale of pay and gross pay drawn, nature of work), current activities, and the name and address of two referees who know your work. Then sign the declaration. Enclose self-attested photocopies of your degree/diploma certificates and mark sheets. Email the application to [email protected] with the subject line "Application for the post of ………." (write the post name). Send a separate application for each post. Make sure the email reaches by 05.00 PM on 30 October 2026. Late or incomplete applications will not be considered. A hard copy of the form or documents is not needed at this stage. With the application: Self-attested photocopies of degree/diploma certificates and mark sheets Originals to produce at the time of joining, if selected: Educational qualifications Date of Birth Experience certificates One recent passport size photograph Identity proof, i.e. Aadhaar/PAN/Voter ID/Driving License etc. One set of self-attested photocopies of all documents SC/ST/OBC/Disability Certificate, if applicable

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected through a walk-in interview. The tentative date is 3 November 2026 (Tuesday). Candidates must report between 09.30 AM and 10.30 AM at the Seminar Room, Urology OPD, Second Floor of Hospital Building, AIIMS Bhubaneswar. The selection committee or appointing authority will decide who is engaged for each position. A candidate who does not bring the original certificates at the time of joining, or whose documents show a discrepancy, will not be allowed to join. The position will then be offered to candidates on the waiting list.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical), 1 Project Technical Support-III and 1 Project Technical Support-II, in an ICMR-funded project of the Department of Urology.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Bhubaneswar project posts?
faq.answer: Applications in the prescribed format must reach [email protected] by 05.00 PM on 30 October 2026. Late applications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical)?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is Post Graduate (PG) in Life Sciences/Biotechnology, including integrated PG degrees. Experience in the health sector, ICMR, AIIMS, clinical research project management and patient handling is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for Project Technical Support-II?
faq.answer: You need 12th in science + Diploma (MLT/ DMLT or Equivalent) + 5 years' experience in relevant subject/ field, OR a 3-years Graduate degree in relevant subject/field + 2 years' experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 Years for Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) and Project Technical Support-III, and 30 Years for Project Technical Support-II. Age is counted on the date of the walk-in interview. SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates get relaxation as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the AIIMS Bhubaneswar project posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay is Rs. 56000/- per month for Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical), Rs. 28000/- for Project Technical Support-III and Rs. 20,000/- for Project Technical Support-II, each plus HRA @20%.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes. Each post gets HRA @20% in addition to its monthly pay. Provident Fund, Pension Scheme, Leave Travel Concession and Medical claim benefits are not admissible.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed application form and email it to [email protected] with the subject line "Application for the post of ……." by 05.00 PM on 30 October 2026. No hard copy is needed at this stage.

faq.question: Q9. When and where is the AIIMS Bhubaneswar walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The tentative date is 3 November 2026 (Tuesday). Report between 09.30 AM and 10.30 AM at the Seminar Room, Urology OPD, Second Floor of Hospital Building, AIIMS Bhubaneswar.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job, and can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: No, it is not permanent. The posts are on temporary contract for 11 months, may be extended, and give no claim to a regular post. You may apply for more than one post, but you must send a separate application for each post.
